en_US.title: PDA Evidence Tier Label Rule
en_US.scanner: Presentation rule: PDA evidence uses tier labels for rumor, artifact, physical proof, receiver authority and ending record.
en_US.terminal: PDA LABELS: do not color truth as good/bad. Label custody strength, proof stage, spoiler gate and receiver pressure.
en_US.audio: The PDA should tell you how strong the proof is, not what to feel.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Evidence tier labels keep the codex readable across long campaigns without turning mystery into checklist morality.
en_US.external_site: In-game documents are organized by evidence strength and custody, not by quest-good or quest-bad labels.
en_US.field_note: PDA label record: evidence tier labels and glossary terms must remain readable, stable, and localization-safe.

en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 reveals ecology and machine contamination through staged evidence, not instant lore dumps.
